requirement: OTP login, personal Gmail; spreadsheets owner-only
repo_evidence: `Auth.gs`; sheets protected (`protectAllSheets_`); authenticator app added in 0.15 — `harness`, `phase16`. 0.37: authenticator for every user (CEO exempt), 12-hour / 7-day sessions, idle lock on the server, go-live button, weekly backups, incident log (CHG-79, CHG-82) — `phase37`
assessment: Frappe provides user accounts and OTP-app authentication. Reproduce the exact CEO exception, trusted-device, session, idle-lock and incident policies separately. Google owner-only Sheet protection is not the new storage model.

requirement: AuthService swappable for Workspace identity
repo_evidence: Sign-in lives in `Auth.gs` / `Security.gs` only; services take a session context
assessment: Frappe has its own authentication system. Connect the selected identity provider and define account lifecycle; the Apps Script AuthService cannot be copied unchanged.

requirement: Role and scope resolved on the server only
repo_evidence: `Perm.gs`, role check in `api()`; scope per service — all suites. 0.36: separation of duties — CEO queue for top roles / heads, CEO trusted phone + PIN, two-person rule, access review (CHG-74…78) — `phase36`, `phase4`, `ui20`, `ui26`
assessment: Roles and server permissions are available. Kandil's position scopes, CEO phone/PIN route, two-person restrictions and access review need explicit server rules and tests.

requirement: One login shared with the Performance Appraisal portal
assessment: Shared login with another portal requires an identity integration. This requirement is also deferred in the source repo.

requirement: Same design and spirit as the Performance Appraisal portal
repo_evidence: Greeting, «المطلوب منك», idle lock, remember-me, guide. 0.42: new look (CHG-87) — section colours, inbox home with filters, global search checked per kind on the server, stage board with drag-to-move, tabbed candidate file, guided offer steps — `phase42`, `ui43`
assessment: Desk lists, forms and Kanban are available. The exact Arabic inbox, candidate tabs, offer wizard and cross-module experience require UI work.

requirement: Job, Position, Employee, Vacancy as separate entities
assessment: Employee, Department, Designation and Job Opening exist. Add Kandil Position as an occupied or vacant organizational seat, distinct from a job title and recruitment opening.

requirement: Versioned organization; closed positions kept
repo_evidence: Unit / position history and closing (never delete) — `orgadmin`. **Missing:** full structure version snapshots (`Structural.gs`: "come later")
assessment: Document change history is available. Full organization snapshots and dated structural versions require a model; the source repo itself marks these incomplete.

requirement: Structured, versioned JD with view / print / PDF / email
repo_evidence: Versions, approval, view, print / PDF — `phase5`. E-mail (0.28): the approved version in the mail + PDF, to portal users only (owner decision, no candidates), up to 10, audited — `phase28`, `ui32`. 0.42.1: responsibilities by job level (CHG-88), 3 … 16, a reason above the band. 0.42.2: weighted / monitoring KPIs, weights add up to 100 (CHG-89). 0.43: worker card, certificates, locations from the structure (CHG-90) — `phase42`, `ui8`
assessment: Job descriptions and print facilities are building blocks. Structured approved JD versions, responsibility bands, worker cards and validated KPI weights need custom records and logic.

requirement: Only HR Sector Manager changes grade, salary, benefits, conditions
assessment: Configure role and field permissions for grade/pay/benefits, including exports and API reads. Test with HR Sector Manager and other HR accounts.

requirement: Delegation / acting authority with dates and history
repo_evidence: `DELEGATIONS` with dates; used by approvals — `phase7`. 0.36: delegation by process (approvals / unit's work), the CEO's authority only after his approval (CHG-76) — `phase36`
assessment: The exact dated delegation by process and CEO-approved delegation are additional business rules, not implied by ordinary workflow roles.

requirement: Structural change: chain, HR review, CEO approval, Position ID on approval
assessment: Implement a structural-change request linked to positions and use workflow states for approvals. Create the Position only after the authorized final decision.

requirement: Structure maintained from the portal
assessment: Standard masters can be maintained through forms. The proposed Kandil Position and hierarchy editor need their own interface and permissions.

requirement: Coding of units and jobs, automatic codes
assessment: Naming series and custom code/family fields can implement agreed coding. Existing Kandil IDs must be preserved during import.

requirement: Multi-company (4 legal entities + sister companies)
repo_evidence: Legal entities recorded for privacy notices — `phase15`. **Missing:** separate companies with their own top position for approvals (owner: later)
assessment: Company records provide a stronger base for multiple legal entities. Per-company top approver and record isolation still need explicit configuration and custom routing.

requirement: Structural HC = 1 per position until a manpower plan
assessment: Staffing Plan stores quantities by designation. A one-seat default on each Kandil Position needs the Position model.

requirement: Occupied HC by HR; payroll-sheet import later
repo_evidence: Occupied HC counted from the employee records — `phase4`. **Missing:** payroll-sheet import (owner: later, open item 2)
assessment: Employee records and imports provide the base. Count occupancy against positions; map and reconcile any payroll-sheet import. The repo's payroll import is partial.

requirement: Current / available HC shown as guidance; any number requestable
assessment: Show position-level availability and permit over-capacity requests without accidentally applying the standard offer vacancy block.

requirement: HC exception approved by the HR Sector Manager only (CHG-40/2)
assessment: Create a separate headcount-exception decision with HR Sector Manager authority and an auditable result.

requirement: Available = Structural − Occupied − Open; no double counting
repo_evidence: 0.40: headcount asked for by requests still in approval is reserved — another request for the same position sees it as taken (a request never reserves against itself); the request view shows it — `phase40`, before `phase2`, `phase18`
assessment: Implement a transactional reservation ledger for pending requests, open vacancies and occupancy. Standard offer vacancy validation counts submitted offers; it is a different calculation.

requirement: HC checks warn-only until switched to block
assessment: Provide a Kandil warning-versus-block setting across the full request lifecycle. The standard vacancy check does not express this complete policy.

requirement: Filled HC counts actual joiners only
assessment: Occupancy must change on actual joining, not offer acceptance or submission. Define cancellations, no-shows and reversals consistently.

requirement: Manager requests only positions in his scope, server-side
assessment: Use server permissions but derive allowed positions from Kandil's manager hierarchy, including delegation and direct API calls.

requirement: Current form fields kept (HR-REC-F02)
assessment: Job Requisition is a useful base. Add the agreed HR-REC-F02 fields; related multi-line and routing behavior is covered separately.

requirement: One request, several locations via request lines
assessment: The standard requisition has one designation and department, not Kandil's multiple location lines. Add a parent request with lines and linked openings.

requirement: Chain from structure; missing level skipped; self-approval blocked
assessment: Frappe has workflow conditions and an owner-based self-approval check. Dynamic hierarchy traversal, missing-level skips and requester-versus-creator checks need added logic.

requirement: CEO by HR routing, dated CEO rules, Sector Manager → CEO
assessment: Implement dated CEO routing rules and resolved approver records; role-based workflow transitions alone are insufficient.

requirement: HR Manager approve / reject / return / edit / send to CEO
assessment: Configure approval/return states and implement the special HR edit/reroute actions with permissions and revision rules.

requirement: Requester notified of every step, rejection and HR edit
assessment: Configure notifications for each agreed workflow transition and edit. Custom workflow actions must trigger those events consistently.

requirement: Return for revision with timestamps and versions
assessment: Use history as a base, but preserve formal request revisions, return reasons and timestamps as business records.

requirement: Approval snapshot of what each approver saw
assessment: Store an immutable business snapshot linked to each approval. A general document diff is not the exact payload that an approver saw.

requirement: Request timeline and My Requests
assessment: Filtered lists, ownership filters and document timelines provide the base for My Requests. Configure visibility and displayed events.

requirement: Change request and reapproval for material post-approval changes
repo_evidence: HR edits before approval are versioned and notified. After approval (0.28): owner decision — only a headcount **increase** goes back to approval, as a linked request through the normal chain that tops up the same vacancy; date, specs, priority, employment type, branch and decreases are recorded by HR with a reason as amendment versions — `phase28`, `ui32`
assessment: Implement linked change requests: increases reapprove and top up the same vacancy; other approved changes need reasons and amendment versions.

requirement: Requested priority / HR classification / dynamic score / override
assessment: Add requested priority, HR classification, scored factors and controlled override/pin with recalculation and audit.

requirement: Board approval (Chairman or Vice) after the CEO
repo_evidence: `SEND_BOARD`, on-behalf recording — `phase2`, `phase7`. 0.36: on-behalf needs a proof file (CHG-78) — `phase36`, `ui4`
assessment: Add board routing after CEO and required evidence for on-behalf approval. Generic workflow does not supply this evidence policy.

requirement: One vacancy per location line
assessment: Generate a linked Job Opening or custom vacancy per request location line, preserving parent IDs and approved quantities.

requirement: Partial fill; request closes fully or partially
repo_evidence: 0.40: the request closes by itself («Closed») when all its vacancies are filled, closed or cancelled, and opens again when a fill is voided; event + requester told — `phase40`, before `phase2`, `phase14`
assessment: Standard opening states are Open/Closed. Partial fills, automatic parent closure and reopening on voided fills require coordinated state logic.

requirement: Several recruiters per vacancy; lead; one owner per application
assessment: Assignments provide a base. Add lead recruiter, recruiter team and accountable application owner with their distinct permissions.

requirement: Missing recruitment roles skipped with record
assessment: Implement deterministic HR fallback when roles are missing and record the skipped role and reason.

requirement: Unassigned work queue and bulk reassignment
repo_evidence: v0.33 review: a deactivated recruiter's work did not return to «not assigned» — fixed in v0.34 (`phase34`); bulk reassignment built in 0.28
assessment: Add the exact unassigned queue and reassignment behavior when a recruiter is disabled; test open tasks, applications and vacancies together.

requirement: Recruitment screen listing all approved requests / vacancies
assessment: Configure approved-request and vacancy lists/reports, filters and permissions against the chosen data model.

requirement: Ads per platform from JD templates, copyable
assessment: Job publishing exists. Platform-specific ad drafts, approved JD-version references and copy templates need an advertising model and UI.

requirement: Apply link per ad with automatic source
assessment: Create ad-linked URLs and server-validated source attribution. Website Listing as a default source does not preserve campaign attribution.

requirement: Source mandatory per application, with sub-source
assessment: Job Applicant Source exists. Add sub-source and enforce mandatory source in forms, imports and APIs.

requirement: Subscriptions: credits, usage, expiry, unused-credit alerts
assessment: Build recruitment subscription/credit records, consumption, expiry and unused-credit alerts. No equivalent was identified in the reviewed HR models.

requirement: Referral attribution lock; agency terms
assessment: Employee Referral supplies a starting point. Lock attribution and add agency terms; account for its required email field.

requirement: Person master; candidate ≠ application; duplicate warning, no auto-merge
repo_evidence: `phase3`. 0.38: own consent before passing «Contacted» (consent link), relatives, accommodation, minors, photo consent (CHG-81) — `phase38`
assessment: Standard Job Applicant represents an application and uses email for naming. Add a reusable Person master, identity/dedup rules, consent and linked applications without auto-merging.

requirement: Hybrid journey; recruiter acts on behalf with audit
repo_evidence: Candidate's own page (private link, 7 days): consent, data and CV, confirm / decline interview, answer the offer; recruiter on-behalf kept (CHG-83) — `phase39`, `ui40`
assessment: Build the private expiring candidate journey, offer/interview responses and audited recruiter-on-behalf actions. Standard intake is not the whole journey.

requirement: Online application intake
assessment: Standard online job application intake exists. Adapt fields, Arabic text and branding; email-less intake remains a separate custom compatibility issue.

requirement: Privacy notice acceptance stored with version
assessment: Record consent text version, time, purpose and actor, and enforce consent gates across channels rather than adding only a checkbox.

requirement: Salaries required with disclosure states; never zero
repo_evidence: Owner decision (0.28): salary optional for everyone, the form does not label it optional; a separate sensitive-data consent when entered (0.14.1); zero refused on the form and the server — `phase28`
assessment: Implement optional salary disclosure states, no-zero validation and separate sensitive-data consent. Use the source note's later decision, not its outdated short heading.

requirement: National ID optional at application
assessment: National ID is not required by the standard applicant schema. If added, keep it optional at intake and separately restrict access.

requirement: Bulk import of 50–100 rows with duplicate review and batch ID
assessment: Data Import provides bulk loading. Add reviewed duplicate decisions, Person/Application linkage, batch IDs and predictable rollback/retry handling.

requirement: Hybrid talent pool
assessment: Applicants can be searched and filtered. A reusable person-based talent pool and reassignment to new applications needs the custom candidate model.

requirement: Former employee detection and hiring restriction
assessment: Match against former employees with reviewed identity evidence; add rehire restrictions, reason and override approval.

requirement: Knockout flags for human review; AI evidence-only
repo_evidence: Knockout flags reviewed by a person — `phase9`. AI CV reading (0.31, `CvAi.gs`) gives suggestions only: fields the recruiter picks to save, a summary and a 1–5 match on job-related criteria (age, gender, religion, marital status, nationality, photo excluded); it never moves or rejects a candidate — `phase31`, `ui35`
assessment: No equivalent of this exact AI evidence-only CV workflow was established in standard HRMS. Port human selection, allowed criteria and provider integration with usage controls.

requirement: Coded rejection reasons; internal reason separate from message
assessment: Add coded internal rejection reasons and a separate outward message with independent access and disclosure rules.

requirement: Activity log: calls, manager discussions, no silent edits
assessment: Timeline/comments are available. Use a dedicated append-only activity record with explicit voiding and reasons for calls and manager discussions.

requirement: Action queue with next action per application
assessment: Assignments and tasks provide a base. Configure next-action fields and filtered action queues; special SLA rules remain custom.

requirement: Message templates; copy for WhatsApp
assessment: Email templates are available. Build WhatsApp copy actions and Kandil message templates; copying is not automated WhatsApp delivery.

requirement: Rejection message by WhatsApp or email as an explicit step
repo_evidence: `cand.rejectMsg`; preferred contact channel kept on the person and shown at the rejection step (v0.39) — `phase3`, `phase39`
assessment: Make rejection communication an explicit workflow step, respecting preferred channel and recording actual send versus manual copy/confirmation.

requirement: Vacancy fill method recorded (external / internal transfer)
assessment: Record internal/external fill source and link a transfer or joining event to the vacancy and reservation ledger.

requirement: Internal candidates (source Internal); manager told before first interview
assessment: Link internal applicants to employees and notify their current manager before the defined shortlist/interview transition.

requirement: Practical / technical assessment stage
repo_evidence: `Assessments.gs` — `phase12`. Assessment data entry deferred by the owner (open item 7)
assessment: Skills and interview feedback provide building blocks. Add practical test stages, evidence, scoring and agreed technical assessment content.

requirement: Invite blocked until the manager confirms
assessment: Add a manager-confirmation gate before invitation is sent; prevent bypass through direct APIs and rescheduling.

requirement: Manager screen of interview dates and locations
assessment: Interview schedule fields and filtered views provide dates and managers. Add location fields and role-specific calendar/list views as needed.

requirement: Reminders and optional reconfirmation
repo_evidence: Day-before reminder to the panel by e-mail too; candidate e-mail ~2 hours before a confirmed interview; reconfirmation — `phase12`, `phase39`
assessment: Standard interview and missing-feedback reminders exist. Configure or extend the exact panel day-before, candidate two-hour and reconfirmation rules with duplicate-send protection.

requirement: Check-in, waiting timer, evidence trail
assessment: Create candidate arrival/check-in events and waiting-time calculations. This is distinct from employee attendance check-ins.

requirement: Interview plan, panel roles, waiver with reason
assessment: Use interview participants and types as the base. Enforce panel-role requirements and controlled waivers with reasons.

requirement: Interviewer workspace shows the JD
assessment: Link the approved JD version to a focused interviewer workspace. Merely linking Job Opening does not freeze the interview kit.

requirement: Question bank; HR standard questions in the HR interview
repo_evidence: `INTERVIEW_QUESTIONS` — `phase10`. Bank content pending from HR (open item 8)
assessment: Skill assessment is available. Add question-bank versions and mandatory HR questions; HR must still supply the content.

requirement: Structured, independent evaluations (HR, direct, higher manager)
assessment: Separate feedback per interviewer exists. Exact HR/direct/higher-manager forms and blind or independent visibility need explicit access rules and testing.

requirement: Live comparison; continuous pipeline; decision readiness
assessment: Ratings support comparison. Build the live comparison and decision-readiness conditions across the continuous candidate pipeline.

requirement: SLA on confirmation and evaluation with escalation
assessment: Extend reminder jobs with confirmation/evaluation deadlines, escalation hierarchy, holidays and resolution tracking.

requirement: Offer sent by email from the system or printed
assessment: Job Offer supports applicant, terms, print/letterhead and email workflows. Configure the approved Arabic/English templates and delivery.

requirement: Offer authority by salary band; HR Manager above max
assessment: Add salary-band authority, exceptions and server checks on proposed/approved values. This is not supplied by generic offer status.

requirement: Basic + allowances; incentives in the system, not in the offer
assessment: Model basic, allowances and incentives with separate visibility and print templates; prevent the internal incentive annex leaking into the candidate offer.

requirement: Offer versions and negotiation with reapproval
assessment: Document amendments are a base. Add negotiation rounds, salary-change detection and mandatory reapproval before a revised offer can be sent.

requirement: Valid Until and audited extension
assessment: Add validity, expiry processing and approved extension history; current standard schema does not express this complete rule.

requirement: Five-figure salary trail
assessment: Preserve current, expected, proposed, approved and agreed salary as distinct controlled stages, not one overwritten salary field.

requirement: Decline reasons, over-hiring warning, reserve candidates
assessment: Add decline reasons, reserve-candidate state and over-hiring checks tied to actual joins and reservations.

requirement: Joining date agreed after acceptance, with history
repo_evidence: `phase14`; 0.47 (CHG-101): the fixed-term employment contract prints the two-page preliminary template on the contribution wage, refused while its legal data is missing — `phase51`, `ui51`; 0.48 (CHG-102): the salary details at hire (company copy, pay-view roles, one page) — `phase52`, `ui51`
assessment: Expected joining and appointment-letter templates are available. Add date agreement history, required contract data and separate restricted salary-details printout.

requirement: Did-not-join tracked with reasons
assessment: Add no-show/non-joiner closure, reasons, reservation release and the correct vacancy reopening behavior.

requirement: Upload by employee or HR, HR review, physical receipt
repo_evidence: Private upload link, receipts — `phase14`; 0.46.2 (CHG-100): the signed no-insurance acknowledgement is a required joining document of a no-insurance contract, never deferred or waived — `phase50`
assessment: Private files provide storage. Build employee/recruiter upload permissions, HR verification, physical receipts and non-waivable document rules.

requirement: Deferred documents with approver and due date; HR alerts only
repo_evidence: 0.40: the employee is e-mailed 3 days before and on the due date; 7 days after it the HR manager is told (DOC\_DEFER\_ESCALATE\_DAYS); never on days off; no payroll action — `phase40`, before `phase14`
assessment: Create document deferral records, approving authority, due dates and timed escalation. Keep these notifications isolated from payroll actions.

requirement: Electronic employee file with document versions and expiry
repo_evidence: 0.40: the 13 document states (§14.2) shown on every document; «suspected issue» (only an HR manager clears it) and «replacement requested» (the reason reaches the candidate's link); a verified document past its expiry becomes «Expired» every day, renewal notice 30 days before (employee e-mailed, team told), a renewed copy clears it — `phase40`, `ui41`, before `phase19`
assessment: Attachments and history are available. Add typed employee documents, versions, expiry, renewal, 13 states and HR-only issue clearance.

requirement: Orientation with separate manager and HR screens
repo_evidence: 0.41: IT / administration / safety owners (named in settings, else the HR site specialist) with their own tasks; custody & PPE log on the program and the employee file, flagged at end of service; «arriving tomorrow» screen; survey axes — `phase41`, `ui42`, before `phase19`. 0.44: ZKBioTime enrolment task (face + fingers, punch type, mobile licences, stop on exit — CHG-91) — `phase43`, `ui44`
assessment: Standard onboarding creates tasks/projects and assigns owners. Add Kandil site screens, custody/PPE, arrival dashboard and BioTime enrollment/license tracking; real BioTime sync is a separate integration.

requirement: First-day welcome gift
assessment: Represent the welcome gift as an onboarding task with responsible person, due date and completion evidence.

requirement: 30-day New Hire Voice with confidentiality
assessment: Create confidential day-7/day-30 new-hire surveys and strict HR-only response access; ordinary appraisal visibility is not equivalent.

requirement: Social insurance case within the first month
assessment: Build a social-insurance case with owner, first-month deadline, evidence and escalation. Employee Health Insurance is not this case workflow.

requirement: Transfer process with approvals and HC check on the target
repo_evidence: 0.41: the receiving manager can open (towards his own scope); the two managers give an opinion (an objection is recorded, never ends it) — HR decides; temporary transfer (cover) to an end date — `phase41`, `phase21`, `ui42`
assessment: Employee Transfer exists. Add both managers' opinions, HR final authority, target capacity checks and temporary-cover rules.

requirement: On the effective date: positions / HC move, vacancy updated, history, replacement offered
repo_evidence: 0.41: handover list (ticked, open items named at the move); the old manager offered a prefilled replacement request; a cover keeps the home position and ends by itself — `phase41`, `phase21`, `phase4`
assessment: Standard transfer applies on submission and blocks early submission. Add scheduled effect, home-position retention, automatic return, handover and replacement-request logic.

requirement: Probation checkpoints, log, final evaluation, reminders
repo_evidence: `Probation.gs`, `Probation.html`: one period ≤ 90 days, no extension; goals + acknowledgement, performance log, reviews 30/60, self-assessment, final evaluation on day 75 (annual appraisal items), PIP by day 60, decision by day 80 (ending = HR sector only), reminders and escalation. Checkpoint days in `PROB_CHECKPOINTS` — `phase25`, `ui29`. Stay interview and KPIs in 0.26; the employee sees his follow-ups and, after the decision, his final evaluation (0.27) — `phase27`, `ui31`
assessment: Appraisal, goals and confirmation dates are useful components. Build the precise probation lifecycle: 30/60 reviews, day-75 evaluation, day-80 decision, PIP and restricted termination authority.

requirement: Medical insurance after successful probation
repo_evidence: `MEDICAL_CASES`: opened on confirmation, due in `MEDICAL_ADD_DAYS`, HR only — `phase25`, `ui29`
assessment: Trigger a medical-insurance case from successful confirmation, with due date, restricted access and closure evidence.

requirement: Status report per request; log of calls, appointments, no-shows
repo_evidence: Request timeline and activity log; **Operational reports** screen (0.22): requests, vacancies, candidates, ads, offers, joiners with filters and Excel export — `phase24`
assessment: Standard recruitment analytics and report tools exist. Build the repo's request/activity/no-show reports from the custom event model and match exports.

requirement: Role dashboards; drill-down KPIs
repo_evidence: `Kpi.gs`: KPI screen — process KPIs (speed, quality, efficiency, candidate experience, compliance), scorecards per recruiter, recruitment lead and HR site specialist (weighted, 1–5), managers and approvers; filters, drill-down to cases, Excel export, monthly e-mail. Targets and weights edited on the KPI screen (v0.27, validated + audited); "my evaluation" for every user — `phase26`, `phase27`, `ui30`, `ui31`. Phase 8 part 1 (0.29): source return with cost per hire, bottlenecks per step, interviewer calibration — `phase29`, `ui33`. Hiring forecast (0.30), confidence by months of history — `phase30`, `ui34`
assessment: Appraisal and reporting tools do not supply the exact operational KPIs, weighted recruiter scorecards, source ROI, bottleneck analytics or forecast-confidence method. Port metric definitions and validate denominators.

requirement: Audit: who, what, when, before, after
repo_evidence: `AUDIT_LOG`, `auditDiff_` — all suites; 0.49 (CHG-106): every row sealed and chained, checked daily — `phase53`
assessment: Frappe Version provides change differences. The repo adds HMAC-sealed chained audit rows; reproducing that tamper-evidence needs separate design, key control and verification jobs.

requirement: Controlled overrides instead of admin bypass
repo_evidence: HC exception, waivers, on-behalf, all with reason and audit — `phase7`, `phase10`, `phase14`
assessment: Model each exception explicitly with authorized role, reason and audit. Framework Administrator privileges are not the repo's controlled business-override policy.

requirement: No wage or payroll action anywhere
repo_evidence: Portal records and prints notices only (payroll notice, salary-items notice) — `phase14`, `phase21`
assessment: Keep payroll actions out of recruitment/document workflows and disable unneeded access. HRMS has payroll functionality, unlike this repo; do not enable deductions through document-compliance automation.
